title: Example ADAE dataset — adae
text: processed Adverse Event Analysis Dataset (ADAE) used throughout examples vignettes anaume. derived CDISC pilot dummy data shipped pharmaverseadam package, restricted safety population (SAFFL == "Y") augmented number analysis flags used define adverse event query categories.

title: Example ADAE dataset — adae
Example ADAE dataset — adae
text: tibble 1191 rows 115 variables. Key variables include: USUBJID Unique subject identifier. TRT01A Actual treatment arm. AEDECOD Dictionary-derived preferred term (PT). AEBODSYS Body system organ class. AEREL Analysis flag treatment relatedness ("Y"/"N"). AESER Serious event flag ("Y"/"N"). AEGRD Flag events Grade 3 higher ("Y"/"N"). AEFAT Fatal event flag ("Y"/"N"). AEDISCON Flag events leading drug withdrawal ("Y"/"N"). AEITRR Flag events leading drug interruption ("Y"/"N"). AEREDUCE Flag events leading dose reduction ("Y"/"N"). Additional CDISC ADaM standard variables also included.

title: Example ADAE dataset — adae
text: Derived pharmaverseadam package using preprocessing script data-raw/adamdummy.R.

title: Example ADSL dataset — adsl
text: processed Subject-Level Analysis Dataset (ADSL) used throughout examples vignettes anaume. derived CDISC pilot dummy data shipped pharmaverseadam package restricted safety population (SAFFL == "Y"). serves denominator dataset building adverse event summaries.

title: Example ADSL dataset — adsl
Example ADSL dataset — adsl
text: tibble 254 rows 55 variables. Key variables include: USUBJID Unique subject identifier. TRT01A Actual treatment arm. ARM Planned treatment arm. ACTARM Actual treatment arm description. SAFFL Safety population flag ("Y"/"N"). AGE Age years. SEX Sex ("F"/"M"). Additional CDISC ADaM standard variables also included.

title: Example ADSL dataset — adsl
text: Derived pharmaverseadam package using preprocessing script data-raw/adamdummy.R.
